description.en: The reports of al-Wahidi's Asbab al-Nuzul, each linked to the ayahs Quranpedia.net lists it under. Source passages only: no explanation is added. Text from Quranpedia.net (dump 2026-10-15), links imported as listed there and not yet reviewed by Tarteel editors.

changelog: First version: 447 passages of book 2919 linked to 564 ayah references, imported unchanged from the Quranpedia.net dump 2026-10-15. No claims.
